summary: Marketing is pivoting to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China with SEO and conversion tracking, while redesigning the knowledge website and juggling multiple event and content deliverables due in early September.
summaryDetail: The immediate focus is on executing the decision to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs: the team is analyzing existing participants and CRM leads to build target audience profiles, and Joseph is drafting search-optimized content areas while the team audits conversion tracking. The knowledge website redesign is in progress with feedback from Joseph and others being incorporated by Joker, and Joseph is sharing his alternative HTML design to enhance article showcasing. Meanwhile, several September deadlines are approaching: Melvin must send speaker invitations for the CKGSB luncheon, TIAN Xuefang needs to review the brand video and one-page flyer, Joseph must finalize the newsletter template and fill out the Indonesian SEM contract, and Ira is coordinating event summaries and report edits for Zongchao. The CKGSB-IE report is nearly final, with only the swarm-style globalization section retained per decision. This week, prioritize completing the audience analysis and conversion audit, and ensure all September 3-4 action items are cleared.
